title: The Law Offices of Casey D. Conklin, PLC, Welcomes Attorney Emily Nestor to Its Esteemed Team | User | malvern-online.com
text:
Michigan - The Law Offices of Casey D. Conklin, PLC , a premier legal practice in Michigan specializing in estate planning, business planning, and civil litigation, is proud to announce the addition of Attorney Emily Nestor to the firm. Attorney Nestor will focus her practice on estate planning, business planning, estate administration, probate, trust administration, and other transactional matters.
Attorney Nestor earned her Juris Doctor, Cum Laude, from Western Michigan Thomas M. Cooley Law School in 2022, with a concentration in Business and Estate Planning for Small Business. Additionally, she holds a Bachelor of Business Administration in Sport, Event, and Promotion Management from Cleary University, where she graduated in 2018. Her academic background, coupled with her extensive experience, enables her to offer clients highly knowledgeable and thoughtful legal counsel in the areas of estate planning and business law.
With over a decade of experience in the legal field, Emily has developed a specialized focus on estates, trusts, and business matters since 2020. She previously served as a law clerk for Attorney Casey D. Conklin, where she developed a deep understanding of estate and business planning.
Her time working closely with Attorney Conklin further solidified her desire to pursue a career in this critical area of law. Emily is a proud member of the State of Michigan Bar and has earned a Certificate of Completion in Probate and Estate Planning from the Institute of Continuing Legal Education.
"We are excited to welcome Emily to our team," said Casey D. Conklin, founding attorney of the firm. "Her background and expertise in estate and business planning will be invaluable to our clients. Emily's dedication to providing exceptional legal services aligns perfectly with our firm’s commitment to personalized client care and rigorous legal representation."
The Law Offices of Casey D. Conklin, PLC continues to build on its mission of delivering superior legal services with a focus on individualized attention, trust, and diligent representation. The addition of Emily Nestor strengthens the firm’s capabilities, particularly in the areas of estate and business planning, and further enhances its ability to meet the legal needs of clients throughout Michigan.
About The Law Offices of Casey D. Conklin, PLC:
The Law Offices of Casey D. Conklin, PLC, is a full-service legal firm committed to providing personalized, high-quality legal services to individuals and businesses. The firm’s areas of expertise include estate planning, business planning, civil litigation, tax law, and more. With a client-centric approach, the firm is dedicated to helping clients protect their assets, navigate complex legal matters, and achieve their long-term goals.
